exposure: intravenous iron treatment for iron deficiency anemia
cohort: The study included 136 pregnant women beyond 35 weeks of gestation who received intravenous iron treatment due to iron deficiency anemia.
finding: Temporary regular contractions may be observed in the nonstress test following intravenous iron replacement in pregnant women with iron deficiency anemia who were beyond 35 weeks.
mod_finding: The effect of intravenous iron treatment on contractions may lead to early term birth in pregnant women with a history of cesarean section.
gest_age: beyond 35 weeks of gestation (inclusion); average treatment week 36.82 ± 0.74; average week of birth 38.48 ± 1.60
